text: Devon said Support 'needs real-time visibility.' That sounds obvious -- but it's not buildable until it's specific.
We pinned it down: a 2-minute latency target from event to visible status, and a tie-breaking rule -- status always follows when an event actually happened, never when it simply arrived.
Renata confirmed Operations is genuinely different: next-day by 7am has always been fine, so we're not over-building her side of the pipeline.
That ordering rule matters because trackers reconnecting after a signal gap can deliver events out of order -- a normal occurrence this requirement has to survive.
Next: drawing the line between what ships first and what's sequenced right after it.
